title: Duen Sailing Adventures
specs: Explore the 'Canadian Galapagos' with rich biodiversity and ancient rain forest
View wildlife including black bears, peregrine falcons, humpback and orca whales
Experience cultural heritage sites of the Heiltsuk, Kitasoo, and Haisla people
Sail aboard a classic 1939 Norwegian gaff rigged ketch with heritage and stability
No specific age or weight limits stated
Captain is Transport Canada certified; crew trained in first aid and marine emergency duties
Custom trips available for groups with special interests or family gatherings
Duen certified to carry up to 20 persons on day sail, 16 on overnight expeditions

services.desc: "When this distinguished lady gets moving in a breeze it's a picture to behold; she romps along and overtakes fibreglass youngsters that could be her grandchildren. With a fresh breeze harnessed by her full press of sail, DUEN charges along as if arriving from another era." Jimmy Cornell Cruising World Magazine

blurb: Guests join voyages aboard the mothership Duen to explore coastal wilderness, including ancient forests, native heritage sites, and tidal pools. The trips emphasize wildlife viewing such as whales, bears, and birds in their natural habitats. Frequent shore excursions are guided by expert naturalists or native interpreters.
